themes.prompt: Use Image 1 as the BASE CANVAS that must stay completely unchanged. Image 1 is a high-resolution detailed collage themed around a white vintage handheld game console. Keep the entire collage background unchanged, including all existing titles like 'Sundate time' and 'You get all my attention', all small text notes like 'cutie', and all non-character stickers (headphones, stars, pink hearts, candy, milk carton, white ribbon, fried egg, rubber duck, music notes) in their original positions and style. PHOTO REPLACEMENTS using the user photos (Image 2, Image 3, Image 4, Image 5): Replace the large cutout portrait on the left with the photo from Image 2. Replace the top framed photo with the photo from Image 3, styled to match the collage aesthetic, keeping the nickname text 'Yujinie' intact. Replace the bottom-right framed photo with the warm bright photo from Image 4, keeping the handwritten text intact. Replace the small character photo in the bottom area with the small photo from Image 5. Keep all people as REALISTIC photographs - do NOT convert them to cartoon or illustration. Unify all photo styles to feel coherent, warm, and personal. Maintain the original collage composition and all decorative elements.
